intended_object: An internal step in a recursive construction from a Navier–Stokes proof. It takes the i-th component (i < 4) of a Volterra-system solution at recursion step n and packages it as a smooth, even, holomorphic-in-z element of the library's `AxisFunction S U` type. I inferred this from the docstring ("Step component as an element of `AxisFunction S U`") and from how it is used in the same file.
explanation: The definition takes the raw solution `stepRaw`, proves that its i-th component is jointly smooth, holomorphic in z and even in r, and passes these facts to the library's `symmetrize` constructor to get a bundled `AxisFunction`. It is used only to build the components a, u, k, p of the next step in the slow recursion (lines 2702–2705 of `SlowRecursion.lean`) and in lemmas about those components (`stepComponent_profile`, `stepComponent_axis_zero`). It is an internal piece of a specific proof, packaging data in the library's own types, and does not correspond to any standard object in the literature. So it has no Mathlib counterpart, and neither faithfulness nor generality applies.
